Messages.Author: ravnos...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
This is a situation that came up in our play group. I don't think it
works this way but I gotta ask the question.
I go to bleed my prey. He uses guard dogs to wake up and reduces the
bleed. This leaves him untapped. I go in with my next minion to bleed
and he blocks. He then says the guard dogs said if combat occurs you
get a manuever. It wasn't used this action however. Does he still get
the manuever?
I don't think so; but hey, I have been wrong once or twice.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <8c8bc3$v2k$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, ravnos...@my-deja.com
writes

>I go to bleed my prey. He uses guard dogs to wake up and reduces the
>bleed. This leaves him untapped. I go in with my next minion to bleed
>and he blocks. He then says the guard dogs said if combat occurs you
>get a manuever. It wasn't used this action however. Does he still get
>the manuever?

No. The duration of action modifier cards and reactions is the current
action.

So, the maneuver from Alacrity doesn't carry over onto another action if
you untap. And the maneuver from Guard Dogs doesn't carry over onto
another action if you don't block the current one.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote:
> Just to double-check, if you use Fast Reaction, then the action is
already
> over, right? Thus if you play Guard Dogs (w/ manuever) but then block
with a
> different minion and after that combat, you Fast Reaction with the
Guard Dogs
> minion, the Guard Dogs minion does NOT have a manuever? Thanks!

The action is not already over, since if it were, there would be
no "acting minion" for Fast Reaction to affect (and there would be
no action to react to in the first place).

But, to answer the general question, Guard Dogs (like Rats' Warning)
only provides the combat bonus if that reacting vampire blocks the
action. [RTR 12-JUL-1999]
